review.summary: Single-hunk fix in JuliaSyntax's lexer: `lex_comment` terminated a single-line comment only on '\n' or EOF, so with CRLF line endings the carriage return was consumed into the Comment token instead of being left for the newline/whitespace trivia token. The fix uses `dpeekchar` and stops when the lookahead is '\r' followed by '\n', producing correct token boundaries on CRLF sources.
review.evidence: Minimized production patch touches only src/tokenize.jl, changing the comment-termination condition to also break on '\r\n'. A matching test file (test/tokenize.jl) was modified, and runtime evidence reports a stable differential across 3 repetitions with the full suite passing at the fixed commit. Minimization reports the single hunk as necessary and globally minimal, indicating the token-boundary change alone drives the test outcome.
